plugins.description: 让 AI Agent 用一页石墨风格 HTML 回答复杂问题
plugins.readme_text:
English · 简体中文

Answer me with HTML
in Shimo Style

An agent skill that answers hard questions with a one-page HTML in Shimo Docs style.
Markdown in. One self-contained page out. No server, no build step.

Demo · Install · Theme · Development

The built-in shimo theme. Run am config set mode dark, or use the page toolbar, for the dark variant.

## Why this fork? [Answer me with HTML](https://github.com/QingYunA/answer-me-with-html) already turns a Markdown draft into one clean HTML page. This fork adds a **project-native Shimo Docs theme** and makes it the default, so every page looks like a document someone would actually read. | | Original | This fork | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | CLI, drafts, components, videos | ✅ | ✅ unchanged | | Themes | blueprint · shadcn · paper · 3b1b | + **`shimo`**, built in and default | | Look | technical board / cards / paper | white square page on `#f7f7f7`, 30px/700 title, 15px/1.7 body | | Quality | — | `0 errors · 0 warnings`, WCAG AA contrast | ## ✨ Features | Feature | What you get | | :--- | :--- | | 🎨 **Shimo Docs by default** | White page, thin gray rules, neutral grays and one accessible Shimo blue. | | 📄 **One file, offline** | The output is a single HTML file with inline CSS and JS. No server, no CDN. | | 🧩 **Real components** | Tables, code blocks, callouts, flow / sequence / ER diagrams, charts, timelines, trees and math. | | 🌗 **Light & dark** | Both palettes are token-driven and pass the theme's contrast checks. | | ⚡ **Fast** | The model writes a short Markdown draft; the bundled CLI does layout and SVG coordinates. | | 🧪 **Controlled writing** | The STE check flags wordy sentences and overlong paragraphs before the page is written. | ## 🚀 Install You need [Node.js](https://nodejs.org/) 20 or newer. There is no `npm install` step: the CLI is bundled inside the skill. ### Let your agent install it Paste this into Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, DeepSeek Harness or another agent: > Install Answer me with HTML in Shimo Style: read > https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kanzakivnw/answer-me-with-html-in-Shimo-Style/main/INSTALL.md and follow it. ### One command ```bash npx skills add kanzakivnw/answer-me-with-html-in-Shimo-Style ``` The installer ([vercel-labs/skills](https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills)) asks which agents to install into. ### Claude Code plugin ``` /plugin marketplace add kanzakivnw/answer-me-with-html-in-Shimo-Style /plugin install answer-me-with-html-in-shimo-style@answer-me-with-html-in-Shimo-Style ``` ### DeepSeek Harness plugin ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add github:kanzakivnw/answer-me-with-html-in-Shimo-Style ```
Manual install ```bash git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/kanzakivnw/answer-me-with-html-in-Shimo-Style.git /tmp/answer-me-with-html-in-shimo-style cp -R /tmp/answer-me-with-html-in-shimo-style/skills/answer-me-with-html-in-shimo-style ~/.claude/skills/answer-me-with-html-in-shimo-style ``` Other skill folders: Codex `~/.codex/skills/`, Cursor `~/.cursor/skills/`, OpenCode `~/.config/opencode/skill/`, DeepSeek Harness `~/.dsh/skills/`.
## 🧩 Use Ask a question the way you always do: ``` > Explain the TCP three-way handshake > Redis or Memcached for our cache? > Map out how the modules in this repo fit together ``` The agent writes a short Markdown draft and runs the bundled CLI. The page goes to `~/.answer-me-with-html/pages/` (the same data folder as the original project; install one or the other, because settings and pages are shared). Open it in a browser. Change settings with the agent (`config`), or directly: ```bash am config # show settings; theme defaults to shimo am config set theme auto # content-based theme choice am config set theme shimo # back to the Shimo Docs theme am config set mode dark # dark palette am list # templates, themes, components ``` On the page itself, the top-right toolbar switches theme and light/dark mode, opens comments, and copies the reply Markdown back to the agent. ## 🎨 The Shimo look The theme follows measurements from the Shimo editor (2026-10). Nothing is hand-waved: the tokens below are the same ones the theme checks and ships. | Element | Value | Where it shows | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | Canvas | `#f7f7f7` | page background | | Paper | `#ffffff` + `0 1px 5px rgba(0,0,0,.13)` | square page with a quiet shadow | | Title / body | `30px/700` · `15px/1.7` | document title and prose | | Ink | `#3a3a3a` · `#6b6b6b` · `#9a9a9a` | text, secondary text, metadata | | Rules | `#e7e7e7` · `#efefef` | table borders and hairlines | | Fill | `#f5f5f5` | table headers, code blocks, inline code | | Accent | `#2b68c2` | links, focus rings, highlights | | Diagram | `#d5dae1` strokes · `#eaf2fe` highlights | flow, sequence, ER, charts | The theme source is [`src/themes/shimo.js`](src/themes/shimo.js). A user theme with the same name in `~/.answer-me-with-html/themes/shimo.json` would shadow it; do not install one if you want the built-in version.
Doc template preview

## 🔄 How it works ```mermaid flowchart LR Q[Question] --> D[Markdown draft] D --> C[Bundled am CLI] C --> T[shimo theme tokens] T --> P[Single HTML page] ``` The model never writes HTML, CSS or SVG. It writes the draft; the CLI owns layout, colors, dark mode, diagram coordinates and the writing checks. ## 📁 Project layout ```text skills/answer-me-with-html-in-shimo-style/ the skill: SKILL.md, references and the bundled CLI src/themes/shimo.js the Shimo theme source (built into the CLI) demo/ the GitHub Pages demo (index.md → index.html) .github/workflows/pages.yml renders the demo and deploys it to Pages ``` ## 🛠 Development ```bash npm ci npm run build # rebuild skills/answer-me-with-html-in-shimo-style/scripts/am.mjs npm test ``` `skills/answer-me-with-html-in-shimo-style/scripts/am.mjs` is generated. Edit `src/`, then run `npm run build` and commit both. ## ⚖️ Credits & license Forked from [Answer me with HTML](https://github.com/QingYunA/answer-me-with-html) by QingYunA, MIT. Th

plugins.description: 记住 DeepSeek Harness 桌面版的窗口尺寸：重启后自动恢复、默认水平垂直居中，并提供设置页手动调整。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-window-size

**简体中文** · [English](README.en.md)

记住 **DeepSeek Harness 桌面版**的窗口尺寸：重启后自动恢复、默认水平垂直居中，并且可以在设置页里直接改，不用手动拖窗口。

![平台：Windows](https://img.shields.io/badge/platform-Windows-0078D4)
![宿主：DSH 桌面版](https://img.shields.io/badge/host-DSH%20Desktop-4f6ef7)
![许可证：MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-green)

- **首次启动**：没有记录时使用 **1440 × 900**，并居中。
- **每次手动调整**：自动记录，下次启动恢复。
- **默认居中**：每次启动都把窗口放在当前显示器工作区正中；可在设置页关闭，改为沿用上次位置。
- **不会记错**：最大化、最小化、隐藏状态一律不记录，避免下次以超大尺寸打开；恢复时会按当前显示器工作区收缩，换显示器也能用。
- **设置页**：`设置 → 窗口尺寸` 可手动设定尺寸、记住当前尺寸、立即居中、恢复默认。
- 在非桌面版 Host（`dsh` 命令行、服务器）上仍可加载，但设置页会提示不可用。

## 为什么必须做成 Host 插件

桌面版创建主窗口时把尺寸写死为 `1280 × 820`，也不持久化任何窗口状态。渲染端改不了它：在 Electron 里，`window.resizeTo()` 会被路由到 `WebContentsDelegate::SetContentsBounds`，Electron 只把它转发成 `content-bounds-updated` 事件，**并不会真的改变 `BrowserWindow` 的大小**。

所以真正干活的是 Host 进程：它通过 `koffi`（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-desktop-host` 本来就依赖它）调用 `FindWindowExW` / `GetWindowRect` / `GetDpiForWindow` / `SetWindowPos`，并且**抢在窗口显示前**完成设置，避免先闪一下旧尺寸。

## 设置页

`设置 → 窗口尺寸` 是一个 `settings.section` 条目。页面上会显示当前窗口尺寸、已记录尺寸和上次动作（含时间），并提供：

| 控件 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| 宽度 / 高度 + **应用并记住** | 立刻改变窗口尺寸并保存 |
| **记住当前尺寸** | 把你现在手动拖出来的尺寸存下来 |
| **重新应用** | 用记录值再应用一次（含当前居中设置） |
| **恢复默认** | 回到配置的默认 `1440 × 900` |
| **启动时居中** 开关 | 决定恢复时是否居中 |
| **立即居中** | 只居中，不改尺寸 |
| **启用尺寸记忆** 开关 | 关闭后既不恢复也不记录 |

页面本身不碰窗口，它通过包私有 RPC 通道 `/dsh-window-size` 调用 Host 端，Host 端用与启动恢复同一个控制器来执行。

## 安装

直接从 GitHub 安装（插件管理器里填写）：

```
github:home-i/dsh-window-size#v1.1.2
```

也可以在桌面版 **插件** 页里从本地目录安装。本地开发还可以把包链接进桌面版 profile：

```jsonc
// ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/package.json
{
  "dependencies": {
    "dsh-window-size": "link:/path/to/dsh-window-size"
  },
  "dsh": {
    "profile": {
      "bundles": ["...", "dsh-window-size"]
    }
  }
}
```

下次启动即生效，之后改动源码也不需要重装。

> 不要把这个 `link:` 换成手工建的 Windows junction 再执行 `pnpm install`：pnpm 安装时会移除该条目，而 Windows 会顺着 junction 进入目标目录，导致源码目录被清空。

## 配置

Loader 行里配置首次启动的默认值：

```yaml
# cordis.patch.yml
- insert:
    - id: dsh-window-size
      name: dsh-window-size
      config:
        width: 1440        # 首次启动宽度，CSS 像素
        height: 900        # 首次启动高度，CSS 像素
        center: true       # 每次恢复都居中
        enabled: true      # 是否启用恢复与记录
```

尺寸单位是 CSS 像素；宽高最小被限制为 `520 × 600`，恢复时还会被当前显示器工作区限制。

## 状态文件

记录放在 harness home 下，跟随 profile 而不是 Electron 的 `userData`：

```
~/.dsh/dsh-window-size/window-size.json
```

```json
{
  "size": { "width": 1440, "height": 900 },
  "center": true,
  "enabled": true,
  "last": { "action": "restore", "source": "remembered", "at": 0 },
  "updatedAt": 0
}
```

`last` 记录最近一次动作（`restore`、`resize`、`apply`、`remember`、`center`、`center-on`、`center-off`、`enabled`、`disabled`），包含实际达成的尺寸、DPI 缩放和窗口标题——设置页显示的就是它，出问题时也靠它定位。删除这个文件即回到配置默认值。旧版（只有 size + last）的记录会自动升级：尺寸保留，新开关取配置默认。

## RPC 约定

Host 在 Web carrier 上注册前缀路由，每个请求都先过 `connection.admit`，因此只有本 Host 的已认证页面能操作窗口：

```
POST /dsh-window-size/<endpoint>
content-type: application/json

{ "type": "client-request", "rpcId": "…", "method": "<endpoint>", "payload": … }
```

端点：`status`、`apply`（`{width,height}`）、`reapply`、`reset`、`center`、`remember`、`set-center`（`true|false`）、`set-enabled`（`true|false`）。返回使用 Connection 的 `server-response` 信封；业务失败以 HTTP 200 + `{ ok: false, error: { code, message, details } }` 返回，而路由不存在、非 POST、认证失败分别是 `404` / `405` / `401`。

## 文件

| 文件 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `index.js` | Host 插件入口；启动控制器与 RPC，并负责释放 |
| `window-memory.js` | 控制器：查找窗口、恢复、居中、跟踪缩放、处理页面动作 |
| `rpc.js` | 前缀路由注册、认证、信封解析、端点分发 |
| `win32.js` | koffi 绑定、DPI、显示器工作区、窗口查找 |
| `state.js` | harness home 下的原子 JSON 记录 |
| `client.js` | 设置页（`settings.section`），中英双语 |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | bundle 层插入的 Loader 行 |

## 环境要求

- Windows 10/11 x64 或 arm64。
- DeepSeek Harness **桌面版**（Electron shell 的 Host 进程）。窗口 API 是 Win32 的，其它环境不生效。

## 常见问题

**包管理器操作时报 `dsh: cannot resolve profile bundle "dsh-window-size"`**：说明 manifest 里列了这个 bundle，但 `node_modules/dsh-window-size` 不存在、或其链接目标里没有 `package.json`。插件管理器的 reconcile 阶段对所有已列依赖都会严格解析、没有兜底（而启动时只是跳过并报告），补回链接或重装 bundle 即可恢复。

**设置页显示不可用**：当前 Host 不是桌面版，或 `koffi` / `user32` 加载失败；具体原因会显示在提示下方。

**窗口恢复后的尺寸不对**：查看状态文件里的 `last`，它记录了请求值、实际达成值、DPI 缩放与窗口标题。

## 许可证

[MIT](LICENSE) © home-i

---

[English version →](README.en.md)

plugins.description: Install Z.AI MCP servers into DeepSeek Harness: skill, bootstrap and agent preset.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-zai-mcp

A DeepSeek Harness **user skill** for connecting the Z.AI hosted MCP servers
(ZRead, Vision, Web Reader) to a DSH profile — and, more generally, for adding,
porting and debugging any MCP server:

- one `insert` row with `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` in the profile's
  `cordis.patch.yml`, for `stdio`, `streamable-http` and `sse` transports;
- mapping from other clients (Claude Desktop, Codex, Cursor/VS Code, local
  Go/Python MCP servers, hosted vendors);
- the only correct secret seam: `!!js` environment expressions plus
  `$DSH_HOME/.env` (mode 600) — never a literal token in the config;
- verification (`--dump-config`, an MCP `initialize` probe, restart) and the
  pitfalls seen in practice.

The worked Z.AI example (ZRead, Vision, Web Reader) is in
[`references/zai-mcp.md`](references/zai-mcp.md).

## Repository layout

| Path | What it is |
|---|---|
| `SKILL.md` | the skill itself (frontmatter + procedure), symlinked into `~/.dsh/skills/` |
| `references/zai-mcp.md` | the worked configuration: key source, all four servers, the agent-preset gate, verification, troubleshooting |
| `templates/standard-0.2.1-rc.2.plugins.yml` | the standard agent preset's plugin list, copied verbatim from DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 |
| `templates/zai-mcp-rows.yml` | the four `mcp-client` rows appended to that list |
| `bin/install.mjs` | zero-dependency installer + verifier (`--dry-run`, `--check`, `--global`, `--force`, `--standard`) |
| `bootstrap.sh` | one-command end-to-end setup (skill link, key, preset, verify, optional `--restart`) |
| `AGENTS.md` / `CLAUDE.md` | agent entry points (installation target: DeepSeek Harness) |

## Handing the link to an agent

The repository is written to be driven by an AI agent, whichever harness it runs
in:

- [`AGENTS.md`](AGENTS.md) is the entry point: the target is always DeepSeek
  Harness, and the agent may run inside or outside DSH; the file carries the
  preconditions, the bootstrap command, the key/restart rules and the report
  format;
- [`CLAUDE.md`](CLAUDE.md) points Claude Code at the same file;
- every step is idempotent and self-verifying, so an agent can rerun it after a
  failure without corrupting the profile.

## One-command setup on a new machine

Install and launch DeepSeek Harness once, then paste the link:

```sh
git clone git@github.com:bosenok/dsh-zai-mcp.git ~/src/github.com/bosenok/dsh-zai-mcp \
  && ~/src/github.com/bosenok/dsh-zai-mcp/bootstrap.sh --restart
```

`bootstrap.sh` does everything by itself:

1. picks node (the system one or the runtime bundled with the app);
2. pulls the latest checkout (skipped when offline / the private remote refuses);
3. links the skill into `~/.dsh/skills/dsh-zai-mcp`;
4. provisions `ZAI_API_KEY` in `~/.dsh/.env` — from the credential store of the
   already configured Z.AI provider, `--key`, or the environment — and fails with
   the console link when no source exists;
5. writes the `preset-zai` agent preset through `bin/install.mjs` (idempotent
   managed block between markers);
6. verifies the result: env key, patch rows, and a `--dump-config` of a throwaway
   profile copy;
7. with `--restart`, quits and reopens the app so the new `.env` and preset load.

Afterwards create a new chat, pick the **Z.AI (GLM)** preset and choose a GLM
model in that session; Standard/Creator sessions never mount the servers.

If the Z.AI provider is not configured in DSH yet, either configure it there or
run `./bootstrap.sh --key <token>` with a key from
[z.ai → API Keys → Personal Coding Plan](https://z.ai/manage-apikey/apikey-list).

Manual equivalent (same steps, no bootstrap):

```sh
ln -s "$PWD" ~/.dsh/skills/dsh-zai-mcp
printf "ZAI_API_KEY='%s'\n" "$KEY" >> ~/.dsh/.env && chmod 600 ~/.dsh/.env
node bin/install.mjs
node bin/install.mjs --check
```

### Options

| Flag | Effect |
|---|---|
| `--dry-run` | print the managed block, write nothing |
| `--check` | verify the current state (env, patch, composed profile); write nothing and exit 1 on problems |
| `--global` | mount the four rows at profile level instead of inside the preset |
| `--prune-global` | when installing the preset, remove a profile-level mount left by an earlier setup |
| `--force` | rewrite the managed block even when it already exists |
| `--dsh-home PATH` / `--profile NAME` | target another Harness home or profile |
| `--npx PATH` | absolute npx used by the stdio vision row (default: volta/homebrew probe) |
| `--standard FILE` | build from another DSH version's `presets/standard.patch.yml` instead of the committed snapshot |

Updating the preset after a DSH upgrade:

```sh
# extract the new standard preset from the installed app (or copy it from a source checkout)
npx asar extract-file "/Applications/DeepSeek Harness.app/Contents/Resources/app.asar" \
  node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-bundle-web-app/presets/standard.patch.yml > /tmp/standard.patch.yml
node bin/install.mjs --standard /tmp/standard.patch.yml --force
node bin/install.mjs --check
```

## Install

The skill is a plain directory bundle: `SKILL.md` with YAML frontmatter plus
optional `references/`. DSH's filesystem skill provider discovers it under the
user root (`~/.dsh/skills`), the project root (`<repo>/.dsh/skills`) or
`<repo>/.agents/skills`.

```sh
git clone git@github.com:bosenok/dsh-zai-mcp.git ~/src/github.com/bosenok/dsh-zai-mcp
ln -s ~/src/github.com/bosenok/dsh-zai-mcp ~/.dsh/skills/dsh-zai-mcp
```

A symlink keeps the checkout as the single source of truth: editing `SKILL.md`
here is picked up by the next skill catalog, no restart needed.

## Verify

```sh
ls -l ~/.dsh/skills/dsh-zai-mcp            # -> the checkout
sed -n '1,6p' ~/.dsh/skills/mcp-setup/SKILL.md
```

In a DSH session the skill appears in the catalog as `dsh-zai-mcp`.

# dsh-webdav-sync

用 WebDAV 在多台电脑之间同步 DSH 的配置。备份在**离开本机之前**就用口令封好（AES-256-GCM + PBKDF2-SHA256，600000 轮），所以服务器上自始至终只有一个密文文件 —— 它看不到你的模型目录、插件清单、API 密钥，也看不到密钥属于哪个供应商。

同步的内容是 DSH profile 里的这几样：

| 份（`Part`） | 取自 | 中文名 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `models` | `cordis.patch.yml` 的 `llm-pi-ai` 行 | 模型供应商与模型 |
| `patch` | `cordis.patch.yml` 里其余的 loader 行（MCP、权限预设、UI 设置、insert 块……） | 其余 profile 配置 |
| `plugins` | `package.json` 的 `dependencies` 与 `dsh.profile.bundles` | 已安装插件 |
| `dirs` | 你在「同步内容」里**选择**的目录（profile 之外的绝对路径） | 附加目录 |
| `keys` | DSH 凭据服务里、被上面几份点名的那些 API 密钥 | API 密钥 |

模型配置按 Loader 的覆盖顺序取**最后一个带 `config` 的适用 `llm-pi-ai` 行**；后面的 `disabled` 等元数据行不遮蔽前面的配置。同步保留该配置中 `providers` 的键序和显式 `models` 数组的顺序。宿主界面另有账号/官方供应商优先、内置目录顺序等展示规则；纯 provider 重排也可能要重启 DSH 才反映到运行中的列表。未显式配置模型列表时，列表来自各自宿主的内置目录，目录版本不同仍可能显示不同顺序（[0065](docs/decisions/0065-effective-model-overrides.md)）。

每台电脑各改各的，同步时按份做三方合并，冲突时新的那份胜出、旧的那份留档；服务器上永远只有一份「整个 setup」的版本，而不是 profile 的镜像。

前三份切自 profile 的两个文件，`dirs` 与 `keys` 各是一份自己的东西。`dirs` 是让你把 profile 之外的目录（笔记、提示词、脚本）也带上：在「同步内容」里点附加目录那一行名称右边的**选择目录**（一个不带框的文字按钮），挑一个目录 —— 它连里面的文件一起封进同一个备份，在另一台电脑上恢复时**写回同一个路径**。它只增不减：同步会写会覆盖，但永远不会删掉里面的文件；这一行和其余四份一样有自己的开关（关掉只是「这台不带」，谁也删不掉），详见 [0036](docs/decisions/0036-extra-directories-part.md)。它的开关默认是**关**：目录整份带走，没点名要带之前不动它。

默认模型那一份（`cordis.patch.yml` 的 `agent-default-model` 行）**不在同步内容里**：换一次模型就换一次这一行，带着它只会让每次换模型都成为一次「本机有改动」的同步，而这一行本身没有多少值得跨机同步的东西。它留在各自的电脑上 —— 收集 patch 份时和本插件自己的 loader 行一样被排除（[0056](docs/decisions/0056-drop-default-model-part.md)）。

`keys` 补的是 profile 与「能用的配置」之间的那道缝：DSH 的 profile 里从来不存密钥，只存密钥的**名字**（`apiKeyEnv` / `secretEnv`），真值在本机的凭据服务里（`$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml`）。只同步 profile 的话，另一台电脑会拿到一份完整的供应商列表，然后每个 provider 都报 `MISSING_CREDENTIAL`。这一份把名字对应的值一起带走，同样用口令封在文件里；名字从即将发出的那几份配置里读出来，所以密钥跟着点它名的那一份走。只发**托管存储**里的值（环境导出的不发），**只写不删**，两边都改过时本机赢（凭据没有 mtime，比不出谁新）。详见 [0054](docs/decisions/0054-sync-api-keys.md)。

---

## 参考与来源

设计来自 [magpie](https://github.com/yetone/magpie) 的 `internal/davsync`：同样是「一份密封文件 + 按份三方合并」的思路，本仓库把它移植到 TypeScript 并改成同步 DSH 的配置。

保留了的部分：

- **一份文件而不是镜像**：服务端只存整个 setup 的一个版本（`Bundle`），不是逐文件的目录镜像。
- **按份三方合并**：每个份单独哈希，改一份不会拖着别的份一起走。
- **新者胜 + 败者留档**：两边都改过时保留较新的，另一份写进本机 `sync/` 目录。
- **保守的写入**：读取记录的版本用于 `If-Match`，别的电脑在这中间写过就会被拒绝而不是被静默覆盖。

适配的部分：

- **Go → TypeScript**：一次同步按需进行 HTTP 往返与文件读写；可选的本机转发开启后另有一个随 Host 运行的回环监听器。
- **同步对象改成 DSH profile 行**：magpie 同步的是它自己的配置面；这里同步的是 `cordis.patch.yml` 的 loader 行和 profile 的 `package.json`，所以多了一层 YAML 文档级合并（保留注释、缩进与引号）。
- **`node_modules` 不参与同步**：只同步声明，包在同一台机器上用 pnpm 重新装（见「插件为什么不整目录同步」）。

---

## 安装

这是一个 DSH 插件，由 Host 半边（Node 侧）和浏览器半边（设置卡片）组成。装到 profile 里：

```bash
# 在 profile 目录里（$DSH_PROFILE_DIR，或 $DSH_HOME/profiles/<profile>）
pnpm add dsh-webdav-sync
```

然后在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里加上本插件自己的 loader 行：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: dsh-webdav-sync
      name: 'dsh-webdav-sync'
```

`id` 是配置表单寻址用的 composition entry id（浏览器半边里的 `PLUGIN_ENTRY_ID` 与它一致），`name` 必须等于已安装的包名 —— 浏览器 bundle 按这个名字注册。上面这段就是包内 `cordis.patch.yml` 的全部内容（`package.json` 的 `dsh.bundle.patch` 指向它），所以走 DSH 的 bundle 机制安装时会带上这一行；手动装则需要自己加。

包信息：`dsh-webdav-sync`，版本 `0.1.0`，MIT。

装好后重新加载界面，Settings 里会出现「WebDAV 同步」一页，Plugins 页上对应这张卡片也会出现。

---

## 配置项

配置存在 profile 的 `.dsh-webdav-sync/sync.json`（权限 `0600`），不在 `cordis.patch.yml` 里。下表是 `SyncConfig`（`src/wire.ts`）的全部字段：

| 字段 | 类型 | 默认值 | 含义 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `url` | `string` | `''` | WebDAV 地址。填**文件夹地址本身**，例如坚果云 `https://dav.jianguoyun.com/dav/` 或 Nextcloud `https://…/remote.php/dav/files/<用户名>/`；也可以直接填服务器根（`https://dav.example.com`、`http://192.168.1.10:5005`），带不带尾斜杠都行 |
| `user` | `string` | `''` | WebDAV 用户名 |
| `password` | `string` | `''` | WebDAV 密码。发送给服务器（HTTP Basic） |
| `passphrase` | `string` | `''` | 加密口令。**只在本机用**，加密在文件离开本机之前完成；不得与 `password` 相同 |
| `autoEvery` | `number` | `-1` | 自动同步间隔（分钟）。取值来自 `AUTO_CHOICES = [-1, 3, 15, 30, 60]`；`-1`（`AUTO_MANUAL`）表示只在手动点「立即同步」时同步 |
| `models` | `boolean` | `true` | 是否同步模型供应商与模型这一份 |
| `plugins` | `boolean` | `true` | 是否同步已安装插件这一份 |
| `patch` | `boolean` | `true` | 是否同步其余 profile 配置这一份 |
| `keys` | `boolean` | `true` | 是否同步 API 密钥这一份。关掉之后这台电脑不读也不写任何密钥，服务器上那份原样带过 —— 只是「这台不带」，不是「删掉它」。旧配置里没有这个键，读作开 |
| `dirs` | `string[]` | `[]` | 附加目录的绝对路径，按你添加的顺序。列表说「同步哪几个」，开关说「这台带不带」。去掉一个就是「这台不再同步它」（文件不会动）。最多 `DIRS_MAX = 5` 个，每个目录最多 2000 个文件 / 8 MiB，路径必须是绝对的 |
| `dirsEnabled` | `boolean` | `false` | 附加目录这一份的开关，默认关。关掉之后这台电脑不读也不写任何附加目录，列表原样留着，服务器上那份也不动。旧配置里没有这个键，读作关 —— 目录整份带走，默认不动它 |
| `rememberPassword` | `boolean` | `true` | 是否把上游 WebDAV 密码留到下次。关掉后保存到磁盘的 `password` 为空，本次运行仍用内存里的密码；重启 Host 后需重新输入。不影响下面生成的本地转发账号 |
| `headers` | `string` | `''` | 额外请求头，一行一条「名字: 值」，空行与 `#` 开头的行忽略。先于每个请求自带的头写入，同名时以请求自带的为准；给了自己的 `authorization` 就不再补 Basic。同步与本机转发共用。明文，见下节 |
| `relayEnabled` | `boolean` | `false` | 本机转发开关。复用本表的 `url`、`user`、`password`、`headers`，与主表单一起保存；关掉只停止监听，保留端口与本地账号 |
| `relayPort` | `number` | `3426` | 只在 `127.0.0.1` 监听的端口，持久化而非每次启动随机分配；用「换一个端口」显式修改后按同一个「保存」生效 |
| `relayUser` | `string` | `''` | 首次开启转发并保存时生成的本地 Basic 用户名，之后沿用；保存在本机，不上传 |
| `relayPassword` | `string` | `''` | 与 `relayUser` 一起生成并保存的本地 Basic 密码，卡片显示且可复制；不是上游 WebDAV 密码，不受 `rememberPassword` 开关影响 |

对应 JSON 长这样：

```json
{
  "url": "https://dav.jianguoyun.com/dav/",
  "user": "me@example.com",
  "password": "…",
  "passphrase": "…",
  "autoEvery": 15,
  "models": true,
  "plugins": true,
  "patch": true,
  "keys": true,
  "dirs": [],
  "dirsEnabled": false,
  "rememberPassword": true,
  "headers": "",
  "relayEnabled": false,
  "relayPort": 3426,
  "relayUser": "",
  "relayPassword": ""
}
```

### 密码和口令存在哪里

`password` 与 `passphrase` 平时只存在两处：

1. `<profileDir>/.dsh-webdav-sync/sync.json`，mode `0600`（目录本身 `0700`）。
2. 运行中的 Host 进程内存里。

关掉「记住密码」之后，第 1 处不再有 `password` —— 它只留在第 2 处，直到 Host 退出。这不是「不用了」，而是「这次运行照样能用、重启 Host 后要重新输」：每条路由都是重新从磁盘读配置建引擎的，密码若在磁盘上被清空，同一个进程里的同步就会拿一个空密码去认证。见 [0019](docs/decisions/0019-session-password-not-remembered.md)。

**它们永远不会被写进 `cordis.patch.yml`。** 原因是 patch 文件本身就是被同步的几份之一 —— 放进去的密码会被下一个同步打包加密、上传到服务器。同理，插件自己的 loader 行在收集 patch 份时被排除（`SELF_ID = 'dsh-webdav-sync'`），所以这一行不会在机器之间来回跑。

**它们也永远不会下发到浏览器。** 卡片拿到的是 `ConfigView`，其中只有 `passwordSet` / `passphraseSet` 两个布尔值。表单里留空提交的含义是「沿用已存的那一个」（`ConfigureBody` 的约定），不是清空 —— 卡片从来没有能力把一个它从未见过的密钥写回去。

**但「沿用」只在同一个账号内成立。** 保存时会把地址与用户名跟上一份配置比一次（`sameAccount`）：地址或用户名变了、而这次提交又没有给出新密码，那个沿用的密码会被丢掉，而不是跟着发到新服务器上。`normaliseUrl` 会吸收末尾斜杠与空白，所以把同一个地址重粘一遍不算换账号。同一次提交里填的新密码不受影响 —— 它是为新地址给的。口令（`passphrase`）不参与这个判断：它只在本机解密，从来不会被发给任何服务器，所以没有「被发到别的服务」这条路径。见 [0015](docs/decisions/0015-password-not-carried-across-accounts.md)。

**「口令不能等于 WebDAV 密码」这条规矩比的是实际会发出去的那个密码**，包括「不记住密码」时留在内存里的那一个。服务器收到密码就能用它打开这份备份，所以这种情况下口令等于等于没设加密 —— 换句话说这条守卫不能因为密码没落盘就被绕过。手上根本没有密码时（例如新机器用新口令加入），这条规矩无话可说，不会拦。见 [0019](docs/decisions/0019-session-password-not-remembered.md)。

要清掉存下来的密码，用「关闭同步」：`turnOff()` 保存的是 `{ ...config, url: '', password: '' }`。值得注意的是它**不清口令**，也**不清状态**（不是 `saveState` 而是 `saveConfig`）—— 重新填回同一地址时 `stateKey` 会变回原值，那条基线仍然算数，所以「关掉又打开」不会被当成加入一个新文件夹，也就不会拿服务器上的旧 setup 覆盖本机较新的那份。

### 额外请求头

有的 WebDAV 服务器除了 Basic 认证还要别的东西：InfiniCLOUD 之类要 `User-Agent`，套在反向代理后面的要 `X-Api-Key`，也有的直接发 Bearer 令牌。`headers` 就是给这种情况的：

- **一行一条 `名字: 值`**，空行与 `#` 开头的行忽略。名字按 HTTP 的 token 规则校验，写坏的行会在**保存时**就被拒（错误里带行号），而不是等到下一次同步才以一个莫名其妙的 400 失败。
- **先写入，再让每个请求盖过它。** 请求自带的头（`if-match`、`if-none-match`、`content-type`、`depth`、`accept-encoding`）随后写入，同名时以请求自带的为准 —— 否则一个手滑的 `content-type` 就能把上传变成另一种类型，而 412 条件写入也会失效。
- **给了 `authorization` 就不再补 Basic。** 没给才用上面那个 `password` 拼 `Authorization: Basic …`，所以 Bearer 能用，而填了密码的配置行为不变。
- **它不算机密。** 与 `password` / `passphrase` 不同，它明文存在 `sync.json` 里，也明文下发到卡片（表单里可直接编辑）。但它也不进 `stateKey`：换请求头只是换了同一把锁的开门方式，那条「上次同步到哪」的基线描述的还是同一个文件。见 [0034](docs/decisions/0034-extra-request-headers.md)。

---

## 界面

同一张卡片出现在两个位置，共用一份状态（`WebdavSyncCard` 的 store）：

| 位置 | 注册点 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Settings 一页 | `settings.section`，`id: 'webdav-sync'`，`order: 22` | 无条件注册 —— 出问题时用户就是从这里进来的，它必须还在 |
| Plugins 页上的卡片 | `plugins.bundle.config`，按包名 `dsh-webdav-sync` 寻址 | 仅在 Host 正在服务本插件命名空间时才出现；没装 Host 半边就不会冒出一张空卡片 |

`order: 22` 是有意的：Settings 导航栏没有滚动条且高度固定，排太后在窗口不高时会被裁掉。

卡片的三个主要设置区依次是：**服务器**（地址、账号、密码、口令、额外请求头 —— 前四个各占一行，最后一个是多行输入框，每句说明都紧跟在它讲的那个字段的标签下面）、**自动同步**（一排选项卡：关闭同步 / 手动同步 / 3 分钟 / 15 分钟 / 30 分钟 / 1 小时，选中的那个高亮）、

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin that predicts your next message after each reply. Press Tab to accept it as an editable draft; it never sends by itself.
plugins.readme_text:
# Followup Prompt English | [中文](README.zh.md) [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-followup-prompt)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-followup-prompt) [![CI](https://github.com/keliwang/dsh-followup-prompt/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/keliwang/dsh-followup-prompt/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE) > Predicts your next message in [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness). Press Tab to use it; it never sends by itself. After each reply, the plugin guesses what you are most likely to say next and shows it as gray text inside the empty composer. Press **Tab** to turn it into an editable draft, or just start typing and it disappears. - **Unobtrusive**: appears only when the composer is empty; failures and timeouts show nothing and never raise an error. - **You stay in control**: a prediction is only a draft. You always send it yourself. - **Works out of the box**: uses the current session's model by default, with no extra dependencies or services. ## Contents - [Installation](#installation) - [Usage](#usage) - [How it works](#how-it-works) - [Configuration](#configuration) - [FAQ](#faq) - [Upgrade and uninstall](#upgrade-and-uninstall) - [Development](#development) ## Installation Requires DeepSeek Harness `>=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0` (verified on 0.2.1-rc.2) with at least one model configured. **Harness Desktop (Windows, macOS)** 1. In the sidebar, open **Plugins** → **Add plugin**. 2. Enter `dsh-followup-prompt` as the **Package name or address**. In mainland China, set **Registry** to **Mainland China mirror**. 3. Click **Install**, then **Enable now**, and reload the page. If you are told to restart DSH, quit Harness completely and open it again. If npm is unreachable, step 2 also accepts the full path of a `dsh-followup-prompt-.tgz` downloaded from [Releases](https://github.com/keliwang/dsh-followup-prompt/releases). **Harness Web (Windows, macOS, Linux)** Requires Node.js `22.19` or later and pnpm. ```sh npx @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.1-rc.2 plugin --profile web add dsh-followup-prompt npx @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.1-rc.2 web ``` > [!NOTE] > Do not install from the source directory (entering this repository's path as the package address). A directory install cannot find the dependencies that ship with Harness, so the plugin fails to load. To build locally, run `pnpm pack` in this repository and install the resulting `.tgz`. **Verify the installation**: ask a question, wait for the reply to finish, and leave the composer empty. Gray prediction text appears in the composer; press Tab and the text moves into the composer **without being sent**. If no prediction appears, see the [FAQ](#faq). ## Usage When a reply finishes and the composer is empty, the prediction appears where the placeholder would be. | Action | Effect | |---|---| | **Tab** | The prediction becomes a draft in the composer with the cursor at the end, ready to edit | | **Esc** | Closes this prediction; it does not come back for this turn | | Start typing or composing with an input method | The prediction hides; once the composer is cleared, a prediction that was already generated reappears | | Start a new turn or switch sessions | The prediction hides | Reopening a finished session also shows the prediction for its last turn. ## How it works **When the model is called**: only while you are looking at a session whose turn has finished and the composer is empty. The result stays in memory until the next turn starts, so viewing it again is not billed again. Interrupted or failed turns, empty sessions, and subagent sessions are never predicted for. **What the model receives**: a "condensed transcript". Each turn keeps only your message and the visible text of the model's reply; thinking, tool calls, tool output, and the main conversation's system prompt are left out. Each turn appends just one pair of messages at the end, so the provider's prefix cache builds up turn after turn and most input tokens are billed at the cached rate. **Cost**: every prediction is an ordinary model request billed by your provider. If you don't want it, switch the plugin off on the Plugins page; to spend less, give predictions their own cheaper model (`provider` / `model`). **Privacy** - Data goes only to the current session's model, or to the model you set with `provider` / `model`. Nothing is reported to any third party. - Predictions live in memory only. They are never written to the session log or to disk, and are gone after a restart. - Logs record metadata only (latency, token counts, outcome), never conversation content. - There is no server-side content moderation. Predictions that look like secrets are dropped locally, and you always send a prediction yourself. ## Configuration On the **Plugins** page, find **Followup Prompt** in the **Installed** list and click its configure button to open the settings. Click **Save** when you're done; changes take effect right away, no restart needed. The **Model** list shows the models you have already set up in DSH, the same ones you see when switching models in the composer. Pick **Session default** to use whatever model your current session is running. To turn the plugin off, use the switch on its row in the Plugins list. If you are comfortable with profile patches, you can also edit this plugin's `config` directly. > [!IMPORTANT] > `config` in a patch is replaced as a whole, not merged. When editing by hand, write out every field even to change one; use this package's [`cordis.patch.yml`](cordis.patch.yml) as a reference. Saving from the settings page also rewrites the whole `config`. | Field | Default | Description | |---|---|---| | `provider` / `model` | `''` / `''` | The model used for predictions; both must be set together. Leave empty to follow the current session's model. Same as the **Model** option on the settings page. | | `reasoningEffort` | `'low'` | One of `''`, `off`, `low`, `high`, `max`. `''` uses the model's default; the session's own setting is never inherited. | | `maxTokens` | `8192` | Output token limit, reasoning tokens included. Actual output is usually short; the default leaves room for thinking. | | `timeoutMs` | `30000` | Timeout for one prediction, 2–30 seconds. | | `prompt` | `''` | Advanced: replaces the built-in prediction instruction. | ## FAQ
No prediction ever appears - On the **Plugins** page, check that the plugin's switch is on. - With non-DeepSeek models, `reasoningEffort: 'low'` may not be supported; change it to `''`. - A prediction is given up when the model takes longer than `timeoutMs`; try a faster model or a lower `reasoningEffort`. - Predictions are not shown while the composer contains text or attachments.
Tab does nothing While the slash-command menu or another popup menu is open, Tab belongs to the menu. Close the menu and press Tab again.
The prediction is misaligned Where the prediction is drawn depends on the internal structure of the Harness composer, which can shift after a Harness upgrade. Please open an issue; until it is fixed, switch the plugin off on the Plugins page.
An older version was installed Harness installs plugins with pnpm, which by default holds back versions published very recently (`minimumReleaseAge`) and installs the previous version instead; the install result shows the version actually installed. Wait a while, then reinstall following the [upgrade](#upgrade-and-uninstall) steps.
## Upgrade and uninstall **Harness Desktop**: on the **Plugins** page, find **Followup Prompt** in the **Installed** list and click **Uninstall**. To upgrade, uninstall first, then install again following [Installation](#installation). **Harness Web**: ```sh npx @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.1-rc.2 plugin --profile web add dsh-followup-prompt@latest # upgrade npx @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.1-rc.2 plugin --profile web remove dsh-followup-prompt # uninstall ```

plugins.readme_text:
# DSH Mobile — host plugin for DeepSeek Harness

English | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) | [日本語](README.ja.md)

`@kinocode/dsh-mobile` is a DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin for the DSH Mobile Android app. It lets you:

- Pair your phone by scanning a QR code in the DSH sidebar.
- Use the regular DSH web UI on your phone through an HTTPS gateway running on your computer.
- On phones, let the session title use the available header width and tap it to see the full title. Only the session header reserves space for the floating navigation buttons.
- Answer approval requests and agent questions from notifications in the live desktop session (the first answer from any device wins).
- Receive a notification when a watched session finishes its turn.

The Android app is distributed separately and is not part of this repository. This is an unofficial project, not affiliated with DeepSeek.

## Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness `>=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0`. The range is pinned because the plugin relies on internal DSH Gateway APIs that are not yet stable.
- The DSH web server (`webserver` service), included with DSH Desktop.
- Node.js 22.4 or later (the runtime bundled with DSH Desktop works).
- Phone and computer on the same network, or both on [Tailscale](https://tailscale.com/).
- For notifications: a relay server (see [Notifications and the relay](#notifications-and-the-relay)).

## Install

Add `@kinocode/dsh-mobile` on the DSH Plugins page, or run:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add @kinocode/dsh-mobile
```

Restart DSH. The log should show `[mobile-bridge] gateway listening {"origins":[...]}`.

## Pair a phone

1. Click **スマホを接続** ("Connect phone") at the bottom of the DSH sidebar.
2. In the app, tap **QR を読み取る** ("Scan QR") and scan the code. If you do not have a camera, use **リンクをコピー** ("Copy link") and paste the link into the app.
3. The code is single-use and expires after 5 minutes. Click **新しい QR** ("New QR") to generate another.

The panel also lists paired phones and lets you remove them. Removing a phone revokes its access immediately. The panel is currently available only in Japanese.

On the phone, the DSH sidebar is hidden so the conversation gets the full width. The round button at the top left opens it over the conversation; picking a session or tapping outside closes it. Desktop-only buttons are hidden.

When you add a workspace on the phone, the computer's folders are listed on the phone instead of opening a folder dialog on the computer. Browse to a folder or type its path, then tap **このフォルダを使う** ("Use this folder").

The right sidebar (files, preview, changes review, browser, terminal) opens full screen on the phone. Buttons that open an app or Finder on the computer are hidden on the phone; the file preview offers **スマホに保存** ("Save to phone") instead, which saves to the phone's Downloads. If the page stays blank after DSH restarts, it reloads by itself.

The round buttons at the top left (sidebar) and top right (right sidebar) can be moved anywhere: long-press one, then drag it.

In DSH's built-in browser (the right sidebar's Browser), words that are not an address are searched: Google on the desktop, Bing on the phone. The phone can only show pages that allow being framed (Google and others refuse), so ↗ (Open in system browser) opens the page in Chrome.

## Configuration

All fields are optional. Add them to your profile's `cordis.patch.yml`. A profile patch replaces the plugin's entire configuration, so include every field you want to keep.

```yaml
- id: mobile-bridge
  config:
    relayUrl: https://relay.example.com
    relayEnrollToken: '...'
```

| Field | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `relayUrl` | `''` (off) | Relay used for notifications and answering from them. |
| `relayEnrollToken` | `''` | Token for a relay that only accepts known computers. |
| `gatewayEnabled` | `true` | Run the HTTPS gateway for phones. |
| `gatewayPort` | `3543` | Gateway port (1024–65535). |
| `gatewayHosts` | detected | IPv4 addresses to listen on. Only private addresses are accepted (see below). |
| `hostLabel` | computer name | Name shown on the phone. |
| `previewMaxChars` | `400` | Longest command preview shown in the app (50–4000). |
| `stateDir` | `$DSH_HOME/mobile-bridge` | Absolute path for host identity, paired devices, and certificates. `$DSH_HOME` defaults to `~/.dsh`. |

The configuration ID `mobile-bridge` and log name `dsh-mobile-bridge` are kept for compatibility with earlier versions.

## Phone history loading

Only the phone gateway limits opening history to 40 messages, targeting the latest 10 messages and one turn. Older-page loading remains unchanged. These budgets count user/assistant messages, not tool events or bytes. No DSH core or desktop changes are required.

An authenticated app-shell script saves opening snapshots in IndexedDB. Reopening the same host/device/session advertises verified SHA-256 record hashes; the gateway sends references for matching records and full data for misses. The browser reconstructs the authoritative snapshot before the stock client sees it. Cursor, projections, header, and assistant-stream baseline always come from the current server snapshot, never an optimistic cached replay. Reading the host's log still uses stock DSH; this optimization reduces phone transfer and initial history size, not host disk work.

Only records of at least 256 serialized UTF-8 bytes are advertised, with the hash property limited to 8KiB. If none qualify, no manifest is uploaded. Delta selection accounts for manifest upload as well as download savings. A complete cache miss can still incur the already-uploaded manifest overhead; total traffic is not guaranteed to shrink in every case.

Relay writes are serialized with source pause/resume while the destination drains. Buffered data exceeding 64MiB no longer causes termination. Stock WebSocket's 100MiB per-frame limit still applies; the message-count budget is not a byte limit.

The cache retains opening snapshots only, bounded globally to 12 sessions and 8MiB with a seven-day reuse expiry. Expired entries are removed during a later save/trim; physical deletion while the app is inactive is not guaranteed. It contains conversation text and tool results. On shared devices set `historyCacheEnabled: false` to stop persistence/reuse; this does not erase existing records. Clear the app/WebView's stored data in Android settings to erase them (pairing may need repeating). Revoking a device blocks connections and cache reuse, but does not remotely erase stored data. Storage denial falls back to online loading; a missing reference invalidates that cache entry and reconnects for a full snapshot. Storage is origin-specific, so changing LAN addresses causes a cold load; a stable Tailscale origin improves reuse.

| Field | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `historyEnabled` | `true` | Optimize phone history; false restores stock transport. |
| `historyCacheEnabled` | `true` | Save/reuse device history independently of opening-page sizing. |
| `historyMaxMessages` | `40` | Opening cap, integer 1–500. |
| `historyMinMessages` | `10` | Recent messages before turn alignment, integer 1–cap; defaults to the smaller cap when below 10. |

Restart the DSH process loading this plugin, then reload the phone screen. Run `node --test test/*.test.mjs` for unit/TLS lifecycle tests. For a real Chromium persistence/reload/delta smoke, supply Playwright with `PLAYWRIGHT_MODULE=/absolute/path/to/playwright/index.mjs node test/history-browser.smoke.mjs`; optionally set `CHROME_PATH` to the Chrome executable.

## How it works

- **Gateway.** The HTTPS server listens only on private IPv4 addresses: `10/8`, `172.16/12`, `192.168/16`, and Tailscale's `100.64/10`. Certificates come from a CA created by the plugin. The QR code contains the CA fingerprint, so the app trusts only that CA for this computer.
- **Pairing.** The app generates an ECDSA P-256 key in the Android Keystore and registers the public key using the one-time code.
- **Control requests.** Requests for the pending list, answers, and settings are signed with the device key. The plugin verifies the signature, a timestamp (±5 minutes), and

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness native plugin for aesthete-agent: mechanically validated frontend aesthetics (118-palette evidence library, 4 mechanical gates). 本地运行,零联网
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-aesthete-agent

aesthete-agent(前端美学引擎)的 DeepSeek Harness 原生插件。

把配色决策从"凭感觉"变成"凭检查":118 块实证色板按语域选板,四道机械检查——对比度、色盲模拟、AI 味检测、五维评分——检查不过不交付。全部本地运行,零联网,零 API 密钥(引擎为纯 Python 标准库,需要本机装有 Python 3.8+)。

## 安装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:docsor1212/dsh-aesthete-agent
```

无头模式把 `--profile web` 换成 `--profile headless`。

## 原生工具(17 个)

| 工具 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `aesthete_match` | 按需求自然语言在实证库选板,自动识别语域(素雅/大气/鲜艳/科技感/国风水墨…) |
| `aesthete_directions` | 跨语域方向对比:整页渲染并排,差异铁律,选择回传句 |
| `aesthete_report` | 四道机械检查一键验收,PASS/FAIL 即裁决 |
| `aesthete_matrix` | 全对对比度矩阵+最佳文字/底色配对 |
| `aesthete_blind` | 红绿蓝三型色盲模拟与碰撞风险 |
| `aesthete_score` | 五维评分卡(/20)与修复建议 |
| `aesthete_evidence` | 页面证据卷宗:四闸+静态审计合成验收记录 |
| `aesthete_visualize` | 色板套进 10 类真实 UI 场景渲染自审 |
| `aesthete_recipes` | 表现力技法库:14 条可组合惊艳配方,整页设计前必取 |
| `aesthete_scene` | showcase 级单场景(设备框+证据徽章),紫域守门内置 |
| `aesthete_scaffold` | 四幕明暗旅程整页骨架,对比度自动调墨 |
| `aesthete_tokens` | 全套语义设计令牌(CSS+JSON):墨色自动调墨,强调拆图形/文字双档 |
| `aesthete_audit` | 已有页面机械体检:漂移/渐变/对比对带可执行修复值 |
| `aesthete_chartpal` | 图表用色三型派生:分类/顺序/发散,色盲区分度验证 |
| `aesthete_typescale` | CJK 友好模块字阶:12px 下限,行高配对,tabular-nums |
| `aesthete_qc` | 渲染对账:截图对声明令牌核对大底真伪与板外入侵 |
| `aesthete_narrate` | 量化叙事:实测数字转双语说明,每个数字可溯源 |

自然语言即可触发,无需记命令:"给这个页面配色打个分""要素雅耐看的,出三个方向对比""用 Deep Pine 出一页,再对截图跑渲染对账"。

## 工作流建议

1. **选板**:用 `aesthete_match` 说需求,或 `aesthete_directions` 出跨语域方向对比页,用户点名后按回传句继续;
2. **构图**:`aesthete_recipes` 取技法,挑 3-5 条自由组合;快速起点用 `aesthete_scaffold`/`aesthete_scene`,令牌接线用 `aesthete_tokens`;
3. **验收**:交付前 `aesthete_report`/`aesthete_evidence`,宿主有浏览器工具时对截图跑 `aesthete_qc` 渲染对账,PASS 才交付;
4. **转述**:需要向客户解释"为什么这样配"时,`aesthete_narrate` 出双语纯数字说明。

## 斜杠命令(7 条)

/aesthete-status(自检+台账) · /aesthete-report · /aesthete-match · /aesthete-score · /aesthete-directions · /aesthete-tokens · /aesthete-audit

## 上游

- 引擎与技能本体:[docsor1212/aesthete-agent](https://github.com/docsor1212/aesthete-agent)(MIT)
- 在线演示:https://docsor.cn/aesthete/

## 安全声明(供安装前审查)

- **零联网**:引擎为纯 Python 标准库,安装后与运行全程不发起任何网络请求;
- **子进程**:仅调用本机 `python3`/`python` 执行随插件捆绑的引擎脚本,无其他可执行文件;
- **无安装期脚本**:package.json 不含任何 lifecycle scripts(preinstall/postinstall 等);
- **不读凭据**:不触碰 shell 历史、密钥、浏览器数据;
- **写盘范围**:仅当前工作目录(tokens.css / chartpal.html / *.narration.md / *.evidence.json 等)。

## License

MIT

plugins.description: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 web_fetch 提供可配置的 CIDR 白名单，支持 fake-IP。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-web-fetch-allowlist

中文 | [English](README.en.md)

DeepSeek Harness 内置的 `web_fetch` 会拒绝解析到内网、保留地址段的域名，防止 SSRF 攻击。但这也会导致有内网/透明代理需求的场景下请求失败。
内置插件无法关闭、也无法配置，因此本插件提供一个白名单补丁，支持额外放行一段 CIDR（默认 Clash/mihomo 的 fake-IP 段 `198.18.0.0/15`），其余行为全部沿用内置实现。

## 安装

Plugins → Add plugin，填入：

```
https://github.com/icceey/dsh-web-fetch-allowlist
```

或：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:icceey/dsh-web-fetch-allowlist
```

管理器提示 `restart-required` 时重启或重新启用。

## 行为

- 先走内置 provider 的解析与校验；只有它抛 `WEB_BLOCKED_URL` 时，才尝试白名单。
- 命中就返回地址；不命中就把原来的错误原样抛出，错误码不变。
- 超时、大小上限、重定向、代理、NAT64、字符集等全部由内置实现处理，本插件仅在必要时介入和放行白名单。
- 内置 provider 不存在，或 DSH 升级后内部结构变化时，本插件保持安静、什么都不做。

## 配置

> 如果你是用clash/mihomo且没有调整过fakeip配置，安装后就可以使用，应该不需要调整任何配置。

```yaml
- id: web-fetch-allowlist
  name: 'dsh-web-fetch-allowlist'
  config:
    allowCidrs:
      - '198.18.0.0/15'
```

`allowCidrs` 支持 IPv4/IPv6，设置后替换默认值；无配置时读 `DSH_WEB_FETCH_ALLOW_CIDRS`（逗号分隔）。

plugins.description: VSCode 风格的工作区编辑器：文件树 + Monaco 编辑器 + 子 Agent 面板，适配 DeepSeek Harness 0.2.0-rc.2
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-vscode

VSCode-like workspace editor for DeepSeek Harness: a file tree plus a multi-tab
Monaco editor inside the conversation view, a per-session folder, a panel that
talks to a subagent, and VSCode's keybindings.

中文说明见 [README.zh.md](README.zh.md).

Fork of [`@supanexus/dsh-plugin-file-explorer`](https://github.com/supanexus/dsh-plugin-file-explorer)
(v0.1.0), retargeted at, and substantially extended for, DSH `0.2.0-rc.2`. See
`PATCH-NOTES.md` for the full change log.

## Install

Install straight from GitHub:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "github:yeduwuren20000-del/dsh-vscode"
```

Or clone and link a local checkout:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/yeduwuren20000-del/dsh-vscode.git
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "link:<path-to>/dsh-vscode"
```

Or by hand, in the profile's `package.json`:

```json
{ "dependencies": { "dsh-vscode": "link:<path-to>/dsh-vscode" } }
```

and add `"dsh-vscode"` to `dsh.profile.bundles`. Restart the host afterwards —
the plugin list is read at boot.

## Features

- **Files** view with a center tree | editor split; the left sidebar stays the
  official workspace / conversation list
- One folder per session, holding that session's own files (extracted from the
  session log), with a `相关文件.md` index and a hardlink mirror
- Multi-tab editing, dirty marks, Ctrl/Cmd+S, Markdown source / preview toggle
- Create / rename / delete (non-empty directories are rejected)
- Monaco (CDN) with a Minimap toggle and an imported VSCode theme + colour scheme
- VSCode keys: `Ctrl+P` quick open, `Ctrl+B` tree, `Ctrl+Shift+E` focus tree,
  `Ctrl+W` close tab, `Ctrl+Tab` / `Ctrl+PageUp/Down` cycle, `Ctrl+1..9`;
  Arrow keys, `F2`, and `Delete` also work in the tree
- In narrow layouts the Explorer becomes a drawer and closes after a file opens
- A subagent seat under the editor that follows the current session's model

## Config

`cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: dsh-vscode
      name: 'dsh-vscode'
      config:
        root: 'D:/work'          # change this to your own directory
        openLinksInEditor: false
```

Settings → Plugins → **dsh-vscode** hot-updates these fields.

> `root` is the tree the Explorer opens on. The bundled default in
> `cordis.patch.yml` points at the author's machine, so set it to your own
> directory after installing. A relative or empty value is not recommended —
> under the desktop host it resolves to the app install directory.

## Develop / rebuild

Editable JavaScript source is in `src/`, with its build order in
`src/parts.json`. The original TS/TSX was not preserved in this fork;
the current source was recovered from the working bundle and split into plugin
logic, styles, and vendor snapshots. Build and verify without an engine checkout:

```bash
npm run build
npm test
```

The host loads `lib/`; building regenerates both entry points. See
`src/README.md` for the source layout.

## License

MIT. Original work © SupaNexus; modifications © yeduwuren. See `LICENSE`.

plugins.description: Command-level guard for DeepSeek Harness: allow-by-default rules that ask for approval or deny dangerous shell commands. DSH 命令级守卫：默认放行，命中规则的命令弹审批或直接拒绝。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-command-guard

DSH 的**命令级守卫**：默认一切放行，命中你配置的规则时 `ask`（弹审批等你点）或 `deny`（直接拒绝）。

规则两个维度：`command`（整条命令行的正则）与 `workdir`（工作目录正则）。两者都填是「且」，只填一个则另一维不限制；**第一条命中的规则生效**，其余一律放行。

## 安装

装插件和「让 ask 能弹出来」是两步——DSH 里这是两个独立的旋钮，本插件只管前者。

**第一步：装插件**

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:john-walks-slow/dsh-command-guard
```

pnpm ≥10 的用户按提示把包名加进 profile 的 `pnpm-workspace.yaml` → `allowBuilds`，再重跑一次（插件从源码构建，`prepare` 是自包含的）。建议 pin 到 commit：`github:john-walks-slow/dsh-command-guard#<sha>`。

**第二步：加一档「全权 + 审批」的权限预设**

出厂预设里没有这个组合（`danger-full-access` 绑死 `approval: never`；`workspace-write` 会限制文件写入），所以在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里加一档：

```yaml
- id: permission
  name: "@deepseek-ai/dsh-permission-presets"
  config:
    presets:
      guarded:
        sandbox: danger-full-access
        approval: ask
        name: Guarded
    defaultPreset: guarded
```

- 这一行是**整块替换** `permission` 的 config：若你原本还配着别的预设（`read-only` / `workspace-write` / …），要一并写全，否则会被清掉。
- 不加预设也能用，只要会话的 approval 策略本来就是 `ask`（DSH 未显式设置时的默认值）。但如果会话落在 `never` 档（如 `danger-full-access` 预设），`ask` 规则会退化成硬拒：命令直接失败，并说明命中哪条规则，不会弹窗。

## 规则

```yaml
- id: command-guard          # 行 id 保持 command-guard：设置页按这个 id 找命名空间
  name: dsh-command-guard
  config:
    rules:
      # 丢工作区改动 / 改写历史的 git 命令 → 弹审批
      - name: git-destructive
        command: "(^|[;&|]\\s*)git\\s+((reset|clean|rebase|filter-branch|restore)\\b|checkout\\s+(-f\\b|--\\s+\\.|\\.\\s*($|[;&|]))|push\\s+(-f\\b|--force)|worktree\\s+remove|stash\\s+(drop|pop))"
        action: ask
      # 灾难性形态 → 直接拒绝（不依赖审批策略）
      - name: disk-destructive
        command: "(^|[;&|]\\s*)(sudo\\s+)?(rm\\s+(-[a-zA-Z]+\\s+)*(/(\\s|$|\\*)|~(\\s|$))|mkfs\\.|dd\\s+[^|;&]*of=/dev/|shutdown|reboot)"
        action: deny
      # 某个目录里的一切命令都要问
      - name: system-dirs
        workdir: "^/(etc|opt)(/|$)"
        action: ask
```

正则匹配的是**整条命令行的文本**：命令里只要出现这个形态就算命中——脚本里的示例、注释、乃至 `grep` 的目标都算。所以别把危险命令的原文直接写进命令行。

## 设置页

插件带 web 端面板：设置页里会多出一节 **Command Guard**，可以增删改规则、逐字段编辑。改动写回 profile 补丁，profile 热加载后 `apply` 带着新规则重跑，不用重启 DSH。规则直接用文本编辑器改 profile 同样有效。

## 权限与兼容

- 只拦 `bash` 工具调用，读它的 `command` / `workdir` 两个字段；其它工具完全不经过守卫。
- **不联网、不读写你的文件、不执行任何命令**：`ask` / `deny` 只是把决定交回 DSH 的审批与工具流水线。
- 走 DSH 保留的 `tools/pre-execute` 扩展点；运行时依赖只有宿主供给的 cordis / schemastery。
- `ask` 需要应答者（Web 客户端自带审批 UI）。应答者缺失或策略为 `never` 时按 fail-closed 拒绝——绝不放行。

MIT License.

plugins.description: DSH 会话导出插件：在设置中选择一个或多个会话，导出用户提问与最终回答，支持 Markdown/JSON。
plugins.readme_text: # dsh-session-export 给 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）桌面端 / Web 端的**会话导出**插件。 它只在 **设置** 里增加一个「会话导出」分区，不往侧栏或聊天页塞按钮，避免打断日常界面。 在这里可以： - 选择**一个会话**或**多个会话**； - 选择要导出的内容，默认是**用户提问 + 每次对话的最终回答**； - 按需附加思考过程、工具调用与结果、系统与运行时上下文； - 导出为 **Markdown** 或 **JSON**，多会话会合并成一个文件。 ## 功能 | 能力 | 说明 | | --- | --- | | 单会话 / 多会话 | 会话列表支持搜索、全选、清空和逐行勾选 | | 默认内容 | 用户提问 + 每轮最后一条助手文本回答 | | 可选内容 | 思考过程、工具调用与结果、系统/运行时上下文 | | 输出格式 | Markdown（适合阅读、归档、粘贴到笔记）或 JSON（适合程序处理） | | 标题与元数据 | 导出文件包含会话标题、ID、工作目录、创建/最后活动时间、状态 | | 只读 | 只读取会话日志，不修改会话、不写工作区记账、不删除任何东西 | | 隐私 | 所有内容在 Host 本机生成，不联网、不上传 | ### 默认内容与「最终回答」的判定 - **用户提问**只取真正的用户输入（`source.kind === 'user'` / `user-questions`），不会把运行时的 `runtime-context`、skill 列表、时间上下文当成用户问题。 - **最终回答**取每一轮里最后一条带文本（或图片/文件附件）的 assistant 消息。中间步骤里的 reasoning 和 tool-call 不会被误当成最终回答。 - 如果一轮还在运行、尚未产生最终文本，Markdown 中会标注「本轮仍在进行，暂无最终回答」，而不是 编造内容。 - 一轮已经结束但确实没有文本回答时，会标注「本轮没有文本形式的最终回答」。 ## 安装 仓库地址： 要求 DSH **0.2.1-rc.2** 左右的桌面端或 `dsh web`，Node `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`。 ### 方式一：从 GitHub 安装（推荐） #### 在界面里安装 1. 侧栏 → **插件** → **添加插件**； 2. 在输入框里填： ```text github:vi0let-dev/dsh-session-export ``` 3. 点 **安装**。安装完成后会提示 **「立即启用」**，点它启用这个组合包； 4. **完全退出并重启 DSH**（bundle 行不会热加载）； 5. 重启后按 `Ctrl+Shift+R` 硬刷新页面。 #### 用命令行安装 ```powershell # 跟随 main 分支 dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:vi0let-dev/dsh-session-export # 锁定到某个 tag（推荐，避免以后 main 变化） dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:vi0let-dev/dsh-session-export#v1.0.0 ``` GitHub 直装会在 profile 里放一份副本，不依赖本地插件目录；以后更新插件需要重新安装。 安装后确认 profile 的 `package.json` 里 `dsh.profile.bundles` 包含 `dsh-session-export`， 然后完全退出并重启 DSH。 ### 方式二：本地目录（开发调试） 1. 侧栏 → **插件** → **添加插件**； 2. 输入插件目录的绝对路径，例如： ```text D:\src\dsh-session-export ``` 3. 点 **安装** → **立即启用**； 4. **完全退出并重启 DSH**，再按 `Ctrl+Shift+R` 硬刷新。 命令行等价写法： ```powershell dsh plugin --profile desktop add "D:\src\dsh-session-export" ``` > 本地目录安装是软链接，修改代码后重新加载插件/重启即可，但不要删除或移动原目录。 > 本插件没有构建步骤、没有第三方依赖，不需要 `pnpm approve-builds`。 ## 使用 打开 **设置 → 会话导出**： 1. 在列表里勾选一个或多个会话（默认会选中最近的、已打开的那个会话）； 2. 在「导出内容」里确认勾选项。默认已选： - 用户提问 - 最终回答 3. 选择 **Markdown** 或 **JSON**； 4. 点 **导出**，浏览器会下载文件。 文件名形如： ```text dsh-session-<会话标题>-20261017-2315.md dsh-sessions-3-20261017-2315.json ``` ### Markdown 结构 ```text # DSH 会话导出 > 导出时间 / 会话数量 / 导出内容 --- ## 会话: <标题> - 会话 ID / 工作目录 / 创建时间 / 最后活动 / 状态 ### 第 1 轮 · 时间 #### 用户提问 ... #### 最终回答 ... （勾选思考过程 / 工具调用时，会以折叠块附在对应轮次下） ``` ### JSON 结构 ```jsonc { "app": "dsh-session-export", "version": 1, "exportedAt": 1792249526189, "options": { "user": true, "assistant": true, "reasoning": false, "tools": false, "system": false }, "sessions": [ { "id": "session-...", "title": "...", "cwd": "C:\\...", "createdAt": 1792249261242, "updatedAt": 1792249526189, "turns": [ { "turn": 1, "complete": true, "users": [{ "text": "...", "attachments": [] }], "assistant": { "text": "...", "attachments": [] }, "reasoning": [], "tools": [] } ] } ] } ``` ## 隐私与安全边界 - **零网络**：Host 侧不联网，没有遥测、更新检查或上报；浏览器侧只 `fetch` 同源的 `/api/dsh-session-export/*` 路由。 - **只读**：不写会话日志、不改工作区记账、不删除文件。 - **回环限制**：HTTP 路由只接受本机回环连接，并要求回环 `Host` 头与 `x-dsh-session-export: 1` 标志头。这样跨站页面无法通过简单的 `fetch` 触发导出， DNS rebinding 也会被 `Host` 校验挡下。 - **不打包二进制附件**：默认只导出文本与图片/文件附件的引用（附件 id、文件名）， 不复制附件本体。如果你需要“连附件一起打包”的 ZIP，请使用 DSH 自带的 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-log-export`（会话 Header 菜单里的「下载 Session 日志」）。 - **导出上限**：一次最多 200 个会话，生成结果最多约 32 MB；超过会提示减少会话或内容选项。 - **仓库脱敏**：仓库内不含本机用户名/绝对路径、真实会话 ID、用户邮箱或凭据；README 的示例路径 使用 `D:\src\...` 占位。插件运行时的会话内容只在本机处理和下载，不会写入仓库。 ## 实现 插件分两侧，和 DSH 的其它 UI 插件一样： - **Host 侧** `index.js` - 注册 `/api/dsh-session-export/list` 与 `/api/dsh-session-export/export`； - 列表合并 `sessionPersistence.list()`、活动 `ctx.sessions.list()` 与磁盘会话目录， 标题/时间从 `storages/session_projcache/sessions/.json` 读取，读不到时回退到日志； - 读取时优先用活动会话的 `snapshotEvents()`，冷会话用 `sessionPersistence.open(id, 'read')`，`sessionQuery.readSession(id)` 作为可选兜底； - 把事件归一化为 `turns`，再渲染 Markdown/JSON。 - **浏览器侧** `client.js` - 手写 ModuleLoader bundle，只依赖外壳提供的 `react`； - 向 `settings.section` 注册一个 `order: 37` 的分区； - 所有数据走自己的同源路由；不读取其它插件的 DOM，不挂载全局按钮。 ## 自测 ```powershell node test/smoke.mjs ``` 当前 16 项测试覆盖： - 包名 / bundle patch / client id / locale / icon 一致性； - 默认内容只包含用户提问与最终回答； - 思考、工具、系统上下文按选项出现； - 未结束轮次的「进行中」判定； - Markdown / JSON 渲染、多会话合并、文件名清洗； - 回环 Host 与自定义请求头校验； - `GET /list`、`POST /export`（活动会话与冷会话两条读路径）； - `apply` 的 webServer 路由挂载； - client bundle 的 Settings 分区注册与中英文字典键一致。 ## 已知限制 - 依赖 DSH 的内部服务面（`sessionPersistence`、`sessions`、`settings.section` 等）； DSH 大版本升级后如果这些面变化，需要跟着调整。 - 活动会话导出的是**已提交**的事件快照；正在流式生成、尚未 settlement 的那段回答不会出现。 - 默认不导出二进制附件，只保留引用；工具输出可能很长，勾选「工具调用与结果」时请留意导出体积。 - 列表标题优先取投影缓存；极少数没有投影缓存的冷会话可能显示为「未命名会话」， 但导出文件里仍会从日志的 `session/title` 或首条用户提问补出标题。 - 必须通过 `127.0.0.1` / `localhost` / `[::1]` 访问界面；用自定义域名映射到回环地址时， 插件接口会因为 `Host` 校验返回 403。 - 插件**没有**发布到 npm；请用 GitHub 地址或本地目录安装，不要直接 `dsh plugin add dsh-session-export`。 ## 卸载 界面：侧栏 → **插件** → 已安装 → 找到 `dsh-session-export` → **卸载**。 命令行： ```powershell dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-session-export ``` 卸载后重启 DSH。插件不保留任何持久状态。 ## 版本 - 插件版本：`1.0.0` - 开发/验证环境：DSH `0.2.1-rc.2` 桌面端，Node `24.x` - 许可证：MIT ## 目录 ```text dsh-session-export/ ├─ index.js # Host 半身：列表、读取、导出、HTTP 路由 ├─ client.js # 浏览器半身：Settings 分区 UI ├─ cordis.patch.yml # 挂载 Host 行的 bundle patch ├─ package.json ├─ icon.svg ├─ docs/ │ └─ banner.png # README 顶部横幅 ├─ locale/ │ ├─ zh.json # 插件管理器的中文标题/描述 │ └─ en.json ├─ test/ │ └─ smoke.mjs ├─ README.md ├─ LICENSE └─ .gitignore ```

plugins.description: DSH plugin that cuts model repetition loops mid-stream, prunes them from the session log, and resumes automatically.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-loop-rescue

[English](README.md) · [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

[![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/tag/citydirector/dsh-loop-rescue?sort=semver&label=release)](https://github.com/citydirector/dsh-loop-rescue/releases) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-green)](LICENSE) [![DSH plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH%20plugin-%E2%89%A50.1.7-blue)](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin)

A loop-rescue plugin for DSH (DeepSeek Harness). When the model falls into repetition (`Now. / OK. / Emit. / Producing.` rotations, the same paragraph over and over), it cuts the stream from the inside, **prunes the loop out of what gets written to the session log**, and resumes automatically.

The difference from a plain cut-off: the interrupted message that goes into the next turn's context **contains no loop**, so the model never re-reads its own repetition and carries on repeating.

Requires **DSH 0.1.7 or newer**. Pure JS, no build step.

## Quick start

Use this **or** `@mrweicodes/dsh-loop-guard`, not both: with both on, loops get cut twice.

1. **Install**: sidebar **Plugins** → Add plugin, and give it
   ```
   https://github.com/citydirector/dsh-loop-rescue
   ```
   Switch it on.
2. The defaults work as they are. To watch before it acts, set `mode` to `observe` (see Configuration).

From the command line:

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web remove @mrweicodes/dsh-loop-guard
dsh plugin --profile web add -w github:citydirector/dsh-loop-rescue#v0.1.0
```

Restart `dsh web` after a command-line install. No pnpm build scripts need approving.

## Configuration

The defaults work as they are. To change them, write to the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- set:
    - id: loop-rescue
      config:
        mode: rescue              # rescue: cut + prune + resume | cut: cut + prune | observe: log only
        watch: both               # both | reasoning | text
        marker: true              # leave a "〔N chars of repeated reasoning removed〕" line where it pruned
        maxConsecutiveRescues: 3  # cap on back-to-back rescues; one normal call resets it
        stallCalls: 3             # nudge after this many reasoning-only calls with no output; 0 = off
        stallMinReasoningChars: 1024
        retryTemperature: 1.0     # temperature for the resume request; unset = unchanged
        retryReasoningEffort: low # reasoning effort for the resume request; unset = unchanged
        retryRequests: 1          # how many requests after a resume use the two settings above
        language: auto            # auto | zh | en
        detector:                 # detection thresholds; rarely need changing
          poolWindow: 30
          poolMinCoverage: 0.75
          cycleMinChars: 600
```

Consider running `mode: observe` for a day or two first, check that every `loop-rescue: ... loop detected` line in the log is a real loop, then switch to `rescue`.

## How it works

When the agent loop assembles an `assistant/message`, each block's final content comes from the `block-end` payload, not from the deltas streamed before it. The plugin wraps the model call in the `llm/stream` waterfall:

1. It runs a streaming detector on every reasoning and text block.
2. On a hit it closes every open block: the looping block is replaced by its content **pruned back to where the loop started** (optionally with a one-line marker), and the stream ends with `stop`.
3. The message written to the log holds only the useful content before the loop. The raw stream is still kept in full in the event's `stream` record, where the trajectory view can show it.
4. Once the turn has really ended (`whenIdle()`), it sends a resume message with a correction via `followup()`.
5. The first N requests after a resume can use a different set of sampling parameters.
6. After the cap on back-to-back rescues it stops resuming and leaves a note.

Why not edit the session afterwards: an `assistant/message` cannot carry `sourceEventSeqs`, so the session surface's replace operation cannot swap one assistant message for another. Pruning at `block-end` is the only way that keeps message roles and tool-call pairing intact.

### Detection rules

| Rule | Catches | Prunes from |
|---|---|---|
| Phrase pool `pool` | ≥75% of the last 30 sentences are a handful of recurring short phrases (in any order) | Back to where that batch of phrases first appeared |
| Verbatim cycle `cycle` | The tail is the same text repeated verbatim, period 16–4000 chars, ≥3 repeats, ≥600 chars in total | Keeps the first copy, prunes from the second |

Guarding against false positives:

- A Chinese full stop always ends a sentence; an English period only when followed by whitespace.
- Symbol-only lines (`|---|`, `}`) are not counted.
- List items, table rows and quote lines in the text are not counted.
- The inside of ``` code blocks in the text is skipped entirely.
- The phrase pool needs at least two different phrases rotating.
- It never cuts while an open block holds a tool call: closing a half-written tool call would make the host run it with incomplete arguments.

## Offline scan

Replay past sessions through the same detector the plugin uses, to see where it would cut:

```powershell
node tools/scan-session.mjs <session file or directory>          # hits only
node tools/scan-session.mjs <session file or directory> --all    # hits and misses
node tools/scan-session.mjs <session file> --json
```

Reads plain jsonl and zstd-compressed session files (zstd needs Node 22.15+). The script only depends on `src/detector.js` and runs on plain node.

## Cleaning loops already in the history

The plugin only stops new loops; loops already committed to the history keep being imitated by the model. What DSH sends the model is a frozen projection of the session log, which a plugin cannot change, so the session files have to be cleaned offline **with DSH fully closed**. This works for old sessions that never had the plugin too.

The recommended tool is [dsh-session-manager](https://github.com/citydirector/dsh-session-manager) (`dsm loops`, a single-file exe on Windows): the same detection rules, plus upgrading, archiving and repairing broken sessions.

This repository also ships a lightweight script (Node 22.15+, v4 sessions only):

```powershell
node tools/clean-session.mjs            # list sessions with loops, pick by number; Enter = newest
node tools/clean-session.mjs --dry-run  # show what would change
node tools/clean-session.mjs --undo     # restore from the backup
```

- On Windows you can also double-click `tools\clean-session.cmd`, or drop a session folder onto it; if it cannot find the data directory, pass `--data <data directory>`.
- Only matching `assistant/message` events change: text and reasoning are cut back to where the loop started, `data.stream` is cut to match, and the message's `source.replayState` is removed. Every other line stays byte-for-byte the same.
- It backs up to `<data directory>\sessions-loop-rescue-backup\` first, and refuses while DSH is running (`--force` skips that check; not recommended).
- Versions before 2026-10-17 read only the first frame of a compressed log and wrote the result as a single frame, which DSH treats as corrupt and hides. That is fixed; `dsm repair` brings hidden sessions back.

## Known limitations

- Loop text already streamed into the chat is replaced by the pruned version once the message is committed, but exactly how it redraws depends on the DSH front-end version.
- Loops that span steps (every step is "say a line → call the same tool") are out of scope; that is the job of the built-in `guard/repeat-tool-reminder`.
- `retryTemperature` needs an adapter that supports temperature. DSH has no generic field for Ollama's repetition penalty and similar parameters, so they cannot be set from here.

## Development

```bash
npm install
npm test
```

## Related projects

- [dsh-remote-access-proxy](https://github.com/citydirector/dsh-remote-access-proxy): Use DSH from your phone, tablet, or another computer
- [deepinfra-fusion-proxy](https://github.com/citydirector/deepinfra-fusion-proxy): DeepInfra Standard / Flex switching with automatic fallback, per

plugins.description: Appends a tiny ice marker to the end of every sentence the model writes, chain of thought included.
plugins.readme_text:
# 🧊 dsh-ice-probe

A tiny [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh) plugin that appends a 🧊 marker to the end of **every sentence** the model writes — including its **chain of thought** — and plays a short sound for each insertion.

It is a mechanical output-pipeline transform, **not** a prompt. The model is never asked to add emoji, so it cannot forget, miscount, or imitate.

```
The plan … 
- first read the file … 
- then rewrite it. This keeps things simple.
```
becomes
```
The plan🧊🧊🧊 …
- first read the file🧊🧊🧊 …
- then rewrite it🧊🧊🧊. This keeps things simple🧊🧊🧊.
```
…and you hear a small blip each time a 🧊 lands on the screen.

---

## Features

- **Sentence-end ice for text *and* reasoning.** Implemented on the host `llm/stream` waterfall, so it works for every model call.
- **Survives settling.** The settled copy of a finished step is transformed too, so the ice does not disappear when reasoning collapses.
- **Sound for every insertion.** A short synthesized tone; no audio assets, no downloads. Queue length selects one of four tiers, and a tier drains that many ice markers from the queue.
- **Idempotent.** Text that already has ice in front of its punctuation is left alone.
- **Safe.** Code fences, inline code, numbers (`2.5`), filenames (`core.js`), abbreviations (`e.g.`), tool-call arguments, session titles, compaction summaries and sub-agent/workflow sessions are never touched.
- **No configuration required.** Enable it: it applies. Disable it: the module is unloaded.

## Install

```bash
# from npm (no build step)
dsh plugin add dsh-ice-probe

# or straight from GitHub
dsh plugin add github:uceqi114/dsh-ice-probe
```

Then make sure the plugin is **enabled** in the plugin marketplace. Enabling/disabling the plugin is the on/off switch — there is no in-conversation toggle.

### Manual install

If you prefer to install it by hand:

1. Clone or copy this repository anywhere.
2. Add a link dependency to your profile's `package.json`:
   ```json
   "dsh-ice-probe": "link:D:/path/to/dsh-ice-probe"
   ```
3. Register the bundle in the same file:
   ```json
   "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": ["dsh-ice-probe"] } }
   ```
4. Make sure `node_modules/dsh-ice-probe` resolves to the plugin directory.

## Verify it works

The host half serves two local routes under your DSH web server:

| Route | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `/ice-probe/` | Live counters, the last few rewrites (`samples`), skip counters, last error |
| `/ice-probe/selftest` | The built-in sentence-transform test suite (also `npm run selftest`) |

`/ice-probe/` returning 404 means the plugin is not mounted (disabled in the marketplace, or not installed).

## Behavior and limits

- **Ice goes before the punctuation**, so the sentence stays grammatical and copy/paste keeps normal punctuation at the end.
- **Chinese:** `。 ！ ？ …` always get ice.
- **English:** `! ?` always get ice (a run such as `!!!` counts once). A period only gets ice when it is followed by whitespace, a newline, or the end of the text — so decimals, versions, filenames and abbreviations are left alone.
- **Never iced:** fenced/inline code, tool-call arguments, session titles, compaction summaries, sub-agent and workflow output.
- **The ice is written into the conversation log.** It is part of the assistant message from then on; turning the plugin off does not remove ice from old messages, and the extra characters count toward the context.
- **Sound requires a user gesture** (browser autoplay policy). The first click/keypress on the page unlocks audio; until then ice is counted silently and plays once unlocked.

## Privacy

- Everything runs locally: a host transform and a client-side counter.
- No telemetry, no network calls, no data collection. The two routes above are served by your own DSH web server.
- The plugin only ever *adds* characters to model output; it never rewrites existing text away.

## License

[MIT](./LICENSE)

# dsh-peak-hours · 高峰时段计费提醒

一个给 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）Web 客户端用的纯前端小插件：**工作日高峰时段提醒你「花费 ×2」**，并倒数距离空闲时段还有多久。

> **非官方项目。** 与 DeepSeek 无隶属或背书关系，只是使用 DSH 公开的插件协议。价格与时段以官方页面为准。

## 状态

- 代码只使用浏览器 API（`window` / `document` / `localStorage` / `Date`），无原生依赖、无文件路径，**Windows / macOS / Linux 共用同一份 `client.js`**。
- **Windows 桌面版已实测**：装进 `desktop` profile 后重启客户端，右下角正常出现提醒浮层，宿主能把它加载进浏览器名册。
- **macOS 尚未实测**，代码里没有任何平台相关调用，预期一致；有 Mac 环境的话欢迎反馈。
- 时段判定、周末/节假日、倒计时、拖动定位经过两轮静态复查，尚未补充自动化测试。
- 面向 DSH 现有客户端组合协议（`dsh.client` + `window.__ModuleLoader__` + `cordis.patch.yml`），未做跨大版本兼容。

## 计费口径

依据 DeepSeek 官方 [模型 & 价格](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/zh-cn/quick_start/pricing)：

> 空闲时段价格为高峰时段价格的一半。北京时间周一至周五（不含中国法定节假日）9:00–12:00、14:00–18:00 为高峰时段；其余时段，包括周末及中国法定节假日全天均为空闲时段。

以 `deepseek-flash` 为例（元 / 百万 tokens）：

| | 空闲 | 高峰 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 输入（缓存命中） | 0.02 | 0.04 |
| 输入（缓存未命中） | 1 | 2 |
| 输出 | 4 | 8 |

所以「高峰 = 花费 ×2」成立，**但高峰不是全天**：

- 高峰：**周一至周五 09:00–12:00、14:00–18:00**（北京时间），法定节假日除外
- 空闲（5 折）：工作日其余时间 + **周末全天** + **法定节假日全天**

如果你走的是第三方中转、代理或别的计费体系，这个提醒就不适用。

## 效果

高峰时段（默认展开，橙色）：

```
● 高峰时段 · 花费 ×2                                    –
  现在是工作日高峰（北京时间 09:00–12:00、14:00–18:00），
  token 花费是空闲时段的 2 倍。
  距空闲（5 折）还有 45 分钟
  高峰 周一至周五 09:00–12:00、14:00–18:00
  空闲 其余时段 · 周末与法定节假日全天
                                        本时段不再提示
```

点右上角 `–` 最小化：卡片以右下角为原点缩小淡出，收成一颗胶囊 **`● 花费 ×2`**。胶囊上**点文字**展开，**点边框**是拖动，两种操作不会互相误伤。

倒计时下方有一个勾选项 **「启用提醒（随客户端打开）」**（默认勾选）。**取消勾选 = 彻底关掉提醒**：卡片和胶囊都消失，客户端重启后也不会再出现。想重新打开，按 **`Alt + Shift + P`**（插件一直在后台监听这个快捷键），或者在浏览器里清掉 `dsh_peak_hours_auto_open` 这个 cookie。

**位置随你拖**：按住胶囊边框或卡片标题栏（`cursor: grab`）拖到任意位置，松手即记住，下次打开还在原地；**双击标题栏**（收起时先用文字点开）恢复默认的右下角。展开/收起时浮层以右下角为锚点，不会因为变宽而跑出屏幕；窗口缩小也会自动夹回可视区。

| 操作 | 行为 |
| --- | --- |
| `–` | 最小化，显示「花费 ×2」胶囊 |
| 点胶囊文字 | 展开卡片 |
| 勾选「启用提醒」 | 显示提醒，并在启动、时段切换时自动展开 |
| 取消勾选 | 彻底隐藏（无卡片、无胶囊），重启后也不出现 |
| `Alt + Shift + P` | 重新打开被取消勾选的提醒 |
| 拖动胶囊边框 / 标题栏 | 移动位置，松手保存（拖到窗口外松手也不会卡住） |
| 双击标题栏 | 位置复位到右下角 |
| `本时段不再提示` | 本轮高峰内完全隐藏，进入空闲后自动恢复 |
| 存储 | Cookie `dsh_peak_hours_dismissed / _pos / _auto_open`（主），`localStorage` 同键（回退） |

动画在 `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` 下自动关闭。

## 目录结构

```
dsh-peak-hours/
├── package.json        # dsh.bundle + dsh.client 声明，exports["./client"]
├── cordis.patch.yml    # 往组合树插一行，name 必须等于包名
├── index.js            # host 半侧：空实现，只为让包被扫描到
├── client.js           # 浏览器半侧：__ModuleLoader__ 懒工厂 + 原生 DOM 浮层
├── install-windows.ps1 # 一键安装 / 卸载（Windows）
├── install-macos.sh    # 一键安装 / 卸载（macOS / Linux）
├── LICENSE
└── README.md
```

## 安装

### 方式一：官方 CLI（推荐）

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add <插件目录>
```

`<profile>` 一般是 `desktop` 或 `web`，`<插件目录>` 是本仓库克隆下来的路径。装完**重启客户端**——包清单、exports、client 名册都在进程内缓存。

### 方式二：一键脚本

Windows（PowerShell 5.1+ / 7+）：

```powershell
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\install-windows.ps1 -Profile desktop
```

macOS / Linux：

```bash
PROFILE=desktop bash ./install-macos.sh
```

脚本做两件事，幂等、可逆：

1. 把本目录复制到 `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/node_modules/dsh-peak-hours`；
2. 在该 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 末尾追加一段带 `# >>> dsh-peak-hours >>>` 标记的 `insert` 行。

不会动 profile 里的其他配置。介意脚本改配置的话，手动做这两步效果相同。

### 验证

1. 右下角出现卡片或胶囊；
2. DevTools Console 里 `document.getElementById('dsh-peak-hours-root')` 返回节点；
3. 在客户端地址后拼 `/plugins/dsh-peak-hours/client.js`（本机默认形如 `http://127.0.0.1:4722/plugins/dsh-peak-hours/client.js`）能返回源码。

## 卸载

```powershell
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\install-windows.ps1 -Profile desktop -Uninstall
```

```bash
PROFILE=desktop bash ./install-macos.sh --uninstall
```

或手动删掉 `node_modules/dsh-peak-hours`，再删掉 `cordis.patch.yml` 里那段标记块，重启。

## 配置

改 `client.js` 顶部 `CONFIG`：

| 字段 | 默认 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `peakWindows` | `[{540,720},{840,1080}]` | 高峰窗口，**北京时间分钟数** |
| `peakMultiplier` | `2` | 高峰倍数，用于「花费 ×2」 |
| `offPeakDiscount` | `'5 折'` | 空闲折扣文案 |
| `holidayRanges` | 2026 全年 | 法定节假日区间（含首尾），全天算空闲 |
| `tickMs` | `10000` | 刷新间隔 |
| `margin` | `8` | 拖动/吸附时与视口边缘的最小距离（px） |

### 节假日需要每年维护

`holidayRanges` 目前只覆盖 2026 年（依据国务院办公厅《关于2026年部分节假日安排的通知》，国办发明电〔2025〕7号）。**国务院一般在每年 11 月发布次年安排**，届时在数组里按 `['2027-01-01','2027-01-03']` 的格式追加即可；没追加的年份，节假日会被当成普通工作日（显示为高峰）。

周末的「调休上班日」按官方文字仍属周末，插件按空闲处理。

## 改名 / Fork 注意

包名出现在三个地方，必须一致，否则宿主编不进浏览器名册：

1. `package.json` 的 `name`
2. `client.js` 里 `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id: '...' })`
3. `cordis.patch.yml` 里的 `name:` 和 `id:`

另外 `install-windows.ps1` / `install-macos.sh` 里的 `$PluginName` / `PLUGIN_NAME` 与标记文本也要同步。

## 隐私

- 不联网、无遥测、不读写会话内容，只读本机时间。
- 持久化只有三条偏好：隐藏截止时间、浮层位置、是否跟随客户端自动打开。**以 cookie（`dsh_peak_hours_*`，1 年）为主，`localStorage` 只做回退**——客户端每次启动端口都不同，纯 `localStorage` 会按 origin 隔离而丢失。
- 浮层是 `document.body` 下的一个 `position: fixed` 节点，随插件卸载一起移除。

## 实现要点

- **host 半侧是空插件**：`dsh-client-modules` 只扫描「已启用的 Loader 条目」，所以必须有一行 host row；`index.js` 只导出 `name` 与空的 `apply`。
- **client 半侧不用 React、不注册 slot**：在 `apply(ctx)` 里直接建浮层，不依赖任何 UI 包版本，也不会因为 slot 名字变化而崩。
- **判定全按北京时间**：真实时刻 +8h 换成「北京墙上时间」再读 `getUTC*`，周末/节假日/时段都按北京日历。
- **下一次切换靠逐分钟扫描**（最多 14 天，覆盖春节长假），比手写跨周末分支更不容易错。
- **最小化动画**用 CSS transition + `transform-origin: 100% 100%`，`visibility` 延迟隐藏避免不可见元素仍可被 Tab 聚焦。
- **拖动定位**：位置存的是「浮层右下角」的视口坐标，而不是 left/top，所以展开/收起、窗口缩放都以同一个角为锚点；拖动用 Pointer Events（鼠标、触屏、笔通用）并做指针捕获，超过 4px 才判定为拖动；胶囊内部再分出两个热区——文字展开、边框拖动，靠点击目标与 `e.detail` 区分（键盘 Enter/Space 的 `detail === 0` 也算展开）；松手时把右下角夹回视口内再落盘。
- 清理走 `ctx.effect(() => cleanup, label)`；无 `ctx.effect` 时退回 `beforeunload`。

## 已知边界

- 只在 **Web 客户端（含桌面端 Web 视图）** 生效；headless/TUI 没有 DOM，会静默不挂载。
- 节假日表是静态数据，不会自动更新。
- 官方若调整价格或时段，改 `peakWindows` / `peakMultiplier` / `offPeakDiscount` 即可，但需要手动跟进。

## License
